title: Total of the Last K Marks
description:
Rohan's score tracker needs to compute the sum of the last `k` marks in a list of scores.
If `k <= 0`, return 0.
If `k > len(marks)`, sum all available marks in the list.

hidden_tests.kind: a case where k is larger than the list

hints: Slices and index ranges use boundaries that are easy to misjudge, especially when k is 0 or negative.
Inspect how you slice: in Python, marks[-0:] is equivalent to marks[0:], which selects the entire list!
When k is larger than len(marks), you should clamp the number of summed items to the list length.
Add explicit checks for k <= 0 returning 0, and clamp k = min(k, len(marks)) before slicing or summing.
